pages.text: Eleven sigils work in Dragon's Blood chests, doors and trapdoors: Mending, Binding, Cleansing, Luck, Disorientation, Shrieking, Ruin, Battle, Sentinel, Failure and Purity. Their original shared artwork and names are retained. Craft them at the Sigil Table using its exact five-by-five patterns. These eleven also work as placed sigils; see the Placed Sigils entry for their lifetime and pulse rules.

Mending grants Regeneration I for one hundred ticks, with a six-hundred-tick cooldown. Binding inflicts Slowness VI for three hundred ticks, also with a six-hundred-tick cooldown. Mending targets listed players; Binding targets unlisted players.

Cleansing removes harmful potion effects and preserves beneficial or neutral effects, with a twelve-hundred-tick cooldown. Luck grants Luck I for six thousand ticks and has the same six-thousand-tick cooldown. Both target listed players.

Disorientation applies Fear for three hundred ticks, with a six-hundred-tick cooldown. Shrieking gives one hundred ticks of nausea and plays a ghast cry to the affected player, at normal sound volume in this port. Shrieking has no cooldown. Both target unlisted players.

Ruin and Battle are described in their own entry, including Magic Weakness and Rhino Hide. Sentinel has its own summoning entry. Failure has its own ritual-lockout entry. Purity now removes the restored lesser curses; see its entry and the Curses entry for the current scope.
